title: YaLikeFPS?
description: This is an FPS boosting modpack with other nice features.
body: This modpack aims at being extreemly optimized while having only necessary mods inside so there is no extra bloat slowing down boot times. You can expect at least 2x your normal fps but you will probably get more. The main "selling point" of this modpack is its BLAZING FAST chunk loading, you will never have to wait for chunks to load in and you can create worlds much faster (this isn't as important because you only do it once). Enjoy!
